content.title: NCAA March Madness on Instagram: "RAMS ERASED A 19-PT TAR HEEL LEAD AND ADVANCE 🤯 #MarchMadness #mbb #collegebasketball #vcurams"
content.text: Never miss a post from marchmadnessmbbSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.AS A DUKE FAN I LOVE TO SEEEEEE IT 😂😂😂😂😂😊The street are on fire in RichmondTHATS MY ALMA MATER!! GO RAMSSSS🤯 Comeback complete nothing but grit and focus.My alma mater. I have been a faithful Rams fan since 1975 (Sunbelt Conference). I waa there last night at the Bon Secours Wellness Area in Greenville South Carolina. Yes the Tar Heels fans were strong. All I could see was primary "BLUE." There was so much blue 💙 it blinded me. We VCU fans wasn't as strong as North Carolina fans. VCU was 19 points down in the first half. Coming back into the second half North Carolina continued to put the heat 🥵 on us. Around 500 minutes or into the second half, VCU men's turned the tables on North Carolina. VCU came within 11 points. VCU came within 9 points. Suddenly VCU was down 3 points 72-75. North Carolina went ice cold 🧊. VCU tied the 75-75 to forced an overtime. A new 500 minutes to play in overtime. For the first 200 both teams we're making any shots. VCU would break the ice by scoring the first 2-points in overtime. The rest is history. VCU men's basketball team made a "NCAA MARCHMADNESS HISTORY." As an 11th seed to beat a number 6 seed North Carolina being down 19 points and forcing an overtime to defeat North Carolina by 4-points 82-78. Therefore VCU had score a total of 25-points (19 in regulation and 5 more points in than North Carolina in overtime to win 🏆. I still can't believe it.19 points down under 8 minutes tooIn Vegas watching the game and by the end had converted many a spectator to be VCU fans. What an incredible comeback!VCU showed alot of dawg!!!!🔥🔥This is not upset, only casual pick unc
